title: MENTOR HOMESTEAD INVITES
description: New players can now begin inside a veteran's homestead, with a guest bed, starter chores, shared meals, and a small mailbox for their first party invite.
consequence: The first town has someone waiting.

title: ROOTED WORLD START
description: New saves now begin with one named camp lineage, persistent scars in the terrain, and no seasonal reset pitch interrupting the first shelter.
consequence: The camp chooses roots over flyers.

title: CROSSOVER SQUAD ROTATION
description: The starter squad now cycles through limited crossover allies with branded callouts, temporary poses, and event bios that leave before anyone drops their guard.
consequence: The squad photo keeps changing faces.

title: STARTER VILLAGE ROTATION
description: The opening village now randomizes shopkeepers, neighbor names, festival hosts, and welcome letters each run so no two first weeks feel officially identical.
consequence: The welcome sign forgets who painted it.
